books.title: Understanding Molecular Simulation: From Algorithms to Applications
books.best_chapters: Ch. 2 Thermodynamics and Statistical Mechanics; Ch. 4 Molecular Dynamics Simulations; Ch. 5 Computer Experiments; Ch. 7 Molecular Dynamics in Various Ensembles; Ch. 8 Free Energy Calculations; Ch. 11 Long-Ranged Interactions; Ch. 15 Rare Events; Appendix G Statistical Errors; Appendix H Integration Schemes
books.why: The standard algorithm-level reference connecting statistical mechanics to working MD, free-energy and rare-event methods.

books.authors: Michael P. Allen, Dominic J. Tildesley
books.title: Computer Simulation of Liquids
books.isbn_or_doi: ISBN 9780198803195 (retailers also list 9780198803201 for the paperback); DOI 10.1093/oso/9780198803195.001.0001
books.why: Classic practical MD/MC text with an official companion site of Fortran and Python example programs (also on GitHub).

books.title: Statistical Mechanics: Theory and Molecular Simulation
books.best_chapters: Ch. 17 covers machine learning (new in the 2nd edition).
books.why: Rigorous derivation of ensembles, extended-system thermostats/barostats, reversible integrators and enhanced sampling from Hamiltonian mechanics.

books.title: Molecular Modelling: Principles and Applications
books.why: Broad, readable introduction to force fields, energy minimisation, MD and Monte Carlo with biomolecular examples.

books.title: The Art of Molecular Dynamics Simulation
books.why: Case-study book that builds MD programs step by step, good for students who want to write their own code.

books.title: Molecular Modeling and Simulation: An Interdisciplinary Guide
books.why: Biomolecule-focused text covering force fields, minimisation, MD integration and long-range electrostatics with a mathematical flavour.

books.title: Molecular Dynamics: With Deterministic and Stochastic Numerical Methods
books.why: The mathematically careful treatment of symplectic integrators, Langevin dynamics, thermostats and constraints.

books.title: Introduction to Modern Statistical Mechanics
books.why: Short, clear first course in statistical mechanics aimed at chemists, including Monte Carlo and time correlation functions.

books.title: Statistical Physics of Biomolecules: An Introduction
books.best_chapters: Ch. 12, A Statistical Perspective on Biomolecular Simulation.
books.why: Biomolecule-oriented statistical mechanics with a dedicated chapter on sampling and simulation, pitched at life-science students.

books.title: Molecular Driving Forces: Statistical Thermodynamics in Biology, Chemistry, Physics, and Nanoscience
books.why: Intuitive, example-driven statistical thermodynamics for biophysics students with little physics background.

books.title: Free Energy Calculations: Theory and Applications in Chemistry and Biology
books.why: Edited volume with the theory behind FEP, TI, umbrella sampling and related methods, written by the method developers.

books.title: Statistical Mechanics
books.why: Thorough classical reference for ensembles, partition functions and liquid-state theory.

books.authors: Ernst Hairer, Christian Lubich, Gerhard Wanner
books.title: Geometric Numerical Integration: Structure-Preserving Algorithms for Ordinary Differential Equations
books.why: Definitive mathematics of symplectic and time-reversible integrators and backward error analysis, the theory behind velocity Verlet.

books.authors: Herbert Goldstein, Charles P. Poole, John L. Safko
books.title: Classical Mechanics
books.why: Standard graduate source for Lagrangian and Hamiltonian mechanics and canonical transformations.

books.title: Statistical Mechanics: Entropy, Order Parameters, and Complexity
books.publisher_or_host: Oxford University Press (free PDF hosted by the author)
books.why: Modern, computation-friendly statistical mechanics text with a legal free PDF on the author's page.

notes_courses.title: CHE210D: Principles of modern molecular simulation methods (UCSB lecture notes, F19)
notes_courses.publisher_or_host: UC Santa Barbara, Chemical Engineering
notes_courses.best_chapters: Lecture notes: Classical force fields; Molecular dynamics; Computing properties; Simulations of bulk phases; Advanced molecular dynamics techniques; Free energies along reaction coordinates and biased sampling; Macroscopic free energies and reweighting; Advanced sampling; Coarse-graining and multiscale techniques; and the reading on simulation best practices.
notes_courses.why: Complete, free lecture-note set (18 lectures plus readings and Python/Fortran codes) that follows Frenkel and Smit.

notes_courses.title: CHEM-GA 2600 Statistical Mechanics (NYU; formerly G25.2651) course page and lecture notes
notes_courses.publisher_or_host: New York University
notes_courses.best_chapters: Topics: Lagrangian and Hamiltonian mechanics, phase space and the Liouville theorem; ensembles; molecular dynamics, thermostats and barostats; Monte Carlo; enhanced sampling for free energies; linear response, Green-Kubo and Langevin equations.
notes_courses.why: Author-hosted notes that derive MD algorithms, thermostats and barostats from first principles; linked from Tuckerman's own teaching page.

notes_courses.title: 3.320 Atomistic Computer Modeling of Materials (SMA 5107), Spring 2005 lecture notes
notes_courses.publisher_or_host: MIT OpenCourseWare (CC BY-NC-SA 4.0)
notes_courses.why: Graduate atomistic-modelling course with 25 lectures of notes; materials-oriented rather than biomolecular, so use selectively.

notes_courses.title: 5.60 Thermodynamics & Kinetics, Spring 2008
notes_courses.publisher_or_host: MIT OpenCourseWare
notes_courses.why: Undergraduate-level refresher on thermodynamics and statistical mechanics for chemists.

notes_courses.title: 8.333 Statistical Mechanics I: Statistical Mechanics of Particles, Fall 2013
notes_courses.publisher_or_host: MIT OpenCourseWare
notes_courses.why: Graduate statistical mechanics with full lecture notes, for the theory depth behind ensembles and fluctuations.

notes_courses.title: CS279: Structure and Organization of Biomolecules and Cells (course page and public slides)
notes_courses.publisher_or_host: Stanford University
notes_courses.best_chapters: The slide sets on energy functions and on molecular dynamics simulation.
notes_courses.why: Public slides give a biomolecule-centred MD overview with current ML-force-field readings; the course is now titled 'Structure and Organization of Biomolecules and Cells' and lecture videos are enrolled-only.

notes_courses.title: Classical Dynamics (Cambridge lecture notes)
notes_courses.publisher_or_host: University of Cambridge (author site; old damtp.cam.ac.uk/user/tong/dynamics.html now redirects here)
notes_courses.why: Free, clear notes on Lagrangian and Hamiltonian mechanics, the foundation for the integrator and thermostat theory.

notes_courses.title: Statistical Physics (Cambridge lecture notes)
notes_courses.publisher_or_host: University of Cambridge (author site; old damtp.cam.ac.uk/user/tong/statphys.html now redirects here)
notes_courses.why: Free, well-written notes on ensembles, partition functions and thermodynamics.

notes_courses.title: Kinetic Theory (Cambridge lecture notes)
notes_courses.publisher_or_host: University of Cambridge (author site; old damtp.cam.ac.uk/user/tong/kinetic.html now redirects here)
notes_courses.why: Free notes on Boltzmann equation and transport, background for diffusion and Langevin-type descriptions.

notes_courses.title: Physical Lens on the Cell (online book)
notes_courses.publisher_or_host: physicallensonthecell.org (author)
notes_courses.best_chapters: Chemical Physics (states and kinetics, equilibrium and detailed balance, free energy, diffusion, Markov models); Physical and Molecular Processes; Energy Economy; Molecular Machinery.
notes_courses.why: Free online book from the author's lab on the physics of biomolecular processes, with a chemical-physics section on kinetics, free energy and Markov models.

notes_courses.authors: David L. Mobley, Michael R. Shirts and collaborators (per the course brief)

notes_courses.title: Lessons Learned from the Calculation of One-Dimensional Potentials of Mean Force
notes_courses.publisher_or_host: Living Journal of Computational Molecular Science (LiveCoMS, open access)

notes_courses.authors: Anthony T. Bogetti, Barmak Mostofian, Alex Dickson, A. J. Pratt, Ali S. Saglam, Page O. Harrison, Max Dudek, Paul A. Torrillo, Alex J. DeGrave, Upendra Adhikari, Matthew C. Zweir, Daniel M. Zuckerman, Lillian T. Chong
notes_courses.title: A Suite of Tutorials for the WESTPA Rare-Events Sampling Software
notes_courses.publisher_or_host: Living Journal of Computational Molecular Science (LiveCoMS, open access)

notes_courses.authors: David Hahn, Christopher Bayly, Melissa L. Boby, Hannah Bruce Macdonald, John Chodera, Vytautas Gapsys, Antonia Mey, David Mobley, Laura Perez Benito, Christina Schindler, Gary Tresadern, Gregory Warren

notes_courses.title: Deep Learning for Molecules and Materials
notes_courses.publisher_or_host: Living Journal of Computational Molecular Science (LiveCoMS, open access)

notes_courses.title: Deep Learning for Molecules & Materials (online book, dmol.pub)
notes_courses.publisher_or_host: dmol.pub (author)

notes_courses.title: BioExcel training catalogue (lecture plus hands-on modules, summer schools, webinars)

notes_courses.title: Computational Biochemistry school: 'Lesson 4-1. Enhanced sampling techniques' slides (2024)
notes_courses.publisher_or_host: CECAM

notes_courses.title: MolSSI Education (python-data-analysis and molecular-mechanics tools lessons)

notes_courses.why: Free self-paced lessons on molecular mechanics tools and on Python data analysis.
